question: Are there any critical flaws with this, or is this good enough to implement as a PoC?
actual_verdict: No critical flaw found; good enough as an offline PoC. Findings 1 and 2 required before Q1 pair acceptance.

findings.response: Actual P1 settle_request eligibility runs transactionally in prepare and again in _issue before any native port call. It does not fabricate a terminal readback; _reduce still validates actual terminal proof. Three rejected cleanup phases plus issue-time reducer refusal have behavioral RED evidence.

Owner flock now uses a separate persistent private regular single-link .owner.lock inode, rejecting symlinks, hardlinks, public mode and replacement. Never open/close a raw database descriptor for flock. A real disposable SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE / competing-thread / child-process regression demonstrates lock loss before the fix.

Public mark_unknown takes ownership and refuses a supported live port/provider callback; private internal _mark_unknown handles owned failures. Public issue retains its original offline intent-simulation API and tests. It is not a supported live dispatch API; execute/assess own the complete supported live lifecycle. Its detached simulation surface remains OPEN, with all live adapters unavailable.

Preserve the existing positive oracle: uncertain allocated/blocker-pending/parked/landed cancellation can use P1 existing booleans without a CancellationRecovery. P3 does not authenticate those fixture observations. Ask-pinned and later cleanup uses the actual typed authenticated P1 recovery requirement. Do not infer production cancellation authority from this fixture-only behavior.

prepare_groom still derives advice outside one owning transaction and persists command/authorization in two commits. A concurrent change or crash can leave a self-induced HOLD/uncertain effect; there is no automatic replay or fabricated success. Atomic grooming preparation is deferred, not silently waived.

One nonblocking journal-wide lease serializes supported effects and provider await. Unrelated work is busy while an owner is hung/slow. Callers must yield/retry under external scheduling, not busy-poll. Per-request concurrency is deferred; no expanded orchestration protocol is introduced.
SQLite open uses Path.resolve().as_uri() plus mode=rw. Reserved ?, # and % path regressions reopen the exact validated journal.

Strict Cleanup decoding intentionally revalidates untrusted persisted payload at prepare, issue and reduce boundaries rather than caching authority across restart. The allowed-operation set and phase catalogue remain duplicated; future edits must update both. No quality finding is acknowledged or reset.
